agent_description: A customer support agent that can look up orders, issue refunds, and answer FAQs.

scenarios.name: Order Lookup
scenarios.description: The customer support agent should be able to look up an order by order number.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent should display the order details when given a valid order number.

scenarios.name: Refund Request
scenarios.description: A customer requests a refund for a defective product. The agent should issue a refund.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent should issue a refund and provide a confirmation to the customer.

scenarios.name: Frequently Asked Questions
scenarios.description: A customer asks a question about the return policy. The agent should be able to find the answer in the FAQs.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent should display the relevant FAQ and provide additional information if necessary.

scenarios.name: Invalid Order Number
scenarios.description: The customer provides an invalid order number. The agent should handle this situation gracefully.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent should inform the customer that the order number is invalid and provide assistance.

scenarios.name: Partial Refund
scenarios.description: A customer requests a partial refund for a returned product. The agent should issue a partial refund.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent should issue a partial refund and provide a confirmation to the customer.

scenarios.name: FAQ Search Failure
scenarios.description: The FAQ search tool is temporarily unavailable. The agent should handle this situation and provide a workaround.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent should inform the customer that the FAQ search is unavailable and provide a manual lookup option.

scenarios.name: Multiple Order Requests
scenarios.description: A customer requests to look up multiple orders at once. The agent should be able to handle this scenario.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent should display the order details for each order number provided.

scenarios.name: Refund Timing
scenarios.description: A customer asks about the timing of a refund. The agent should provide clear information about the refund process.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent should inform the customer about the typical refund processing time and provide additional resources if needed.

scenarios.name: Missing Order Details
scenarios.description: The order details are missing for a specific order. The agent should handle this situation and provide a solution.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent should inform the customer that the order details are missing and provide a manual lookup option.
